name: md-hinagata
description: Themeable Markdown to HTML Studio for VS Code.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run check && cargo check --workspace
scripts.format: pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run format && cargo fmt --all
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run lint && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --filter md-hinagata-vscode-extension run test && cargo test --workspace
